name: Lazarz Apartment, Poznan (traced)
note: Traced by hand on the cached plan (1280 x 853 px, evals/real/fetch.ts). No scale bar, dimensions or areas: 54 px/m from the manifest area (68 m2; traced net total 64.0 m2, 94%) cross-checked with the entrance door (48 px = 0.9 m), kitchen counters (32 px = 0.6 m), the double bed (88 x 105 px = 1.6 x 1.95 m), the study's single bed (46 x 100 px = 0.85 x 1.85 m) and the bathtub (88 px = 1.6 m). Tenement walls squared off; the balcony below the bedroom left out (its right-hand opening kept as a door, a guess, the left one as a window). The thick hall/bedroom wall is a pair of slanted walls; the shaft between the study and the bathroom is folded into the bathroom (so the envelope closes); the 0.14 m jog in the living room's north wall above the kitchen are dropped; built-in wardrobes stay inside their rooms (bedroom, hall); the walk-in wardrobe off the hall is a small room. The hall opens to the living room through a leafless doorway (open segment). Kitchen as drawn: an L of base units on the east and north walls with sink and hob on the east run; the shallow cabinet on the east wall by the sofa is left out.
